messages:
maria: Quick sync — partner marketplace launch timeline and press/blog/landing coordination. We need a final go/no-go by Friday EOD PT.

jonathan: copying the content owners. Draft blog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/482 — waiting on CEO quote and partner logo assets.

alyssa: I left comments on the PR with tweaks to the hero copy. Can someone from partnerships confirm the partner-approved logo (SVG) and short partner blurb?

maria: @devon partner sent logo v3.svg and legal greenlit the short blurb. Uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace/press-assets/launch_2026.zip

devon: Partner contact (gcp-ecosys) confirmed embargo window: publish at 09:00 PT on Mon Apr 12. They want a 1-hour heads-up before public. Who owns the pre-announce brief?

jonathan: I can do the pre-brief with partner comms. Need final quote from CEO by Thu noon PT. @maria can you chase? :eyes:

maria: On it. I'll ping ceo and ops for a short quote. Also need approval on the landing page CTA routing — do we send direct to marketplace listing or to a short form + redirect?

alyssa: Recommend direct listing for first 24h to avoid conversion friction. We can route to short form later for lead gen.

tom: Ops note: marketplace listing propagation can take up to 30 minutes after publish. We should schedule listing to go live at 08:55 PT and flip DNS/CTA at 09:00 PT. I'll set a deploy job.

launch-bot: Deploy job created: `marketplace-listing-rollout-176700` scheduled 2026-04-12T08:55:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-releases at T-minus 60m.

jonathan: Press assets checklist: hero + 3 screenshots, 1 explainer GIF, logos (partner + redwood), two bullets of use-cases, CEO quote, partner quote, embargo statement. Is everything in the Drive zip?

maria: Yes — screenshots and GIF there. Missing partner quote (they're drafting) and final CEO quote. Partner said they'd approve quote by Thu EOD PT.

devon: Partner asked for co-blog post timeline: publish partner blog + our blog within 2 hours. We should align timestamps. Can marketing queue both at 09:00 PT and 10:30 PT accordingly?

jonathan: We'll push our blog at 09:00 PT (synced with listing). Partner blog can be scheduled for 10:00 PT to catch APAC. I'll add scheduling to the PR.

maria: Final signoffs: marketing (jonathan) approves blog content; product (alyssa) approves landing copy; partnerships (maria/devon) approves partner assets; ops (tom) approves deploy. If all green by Fri EOD PT, we'll proceed with embargo plan.

tom: I'm good on the deploy steps. I'll run a dry-run on Friday 14:00 PT.

jonathan: I'll get CEO quote by Thu noon or escalate. Adding a short FAQ section to blog for co-marketing FAQs.

maria: Great — I will send a consolidated timeline to partner and create a shared checklist doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devon: FYI — added partner comms lead to the shared doc (alice.gcp). Expect a reply with quote by Thu EOD.

launch-bot: Reminder scheduled: `marketplace-press-check` set for 2026-04-10T16:00:00-07:00 (final internal signoff).
